title: La familia · a family tree
intro: Kinship words only mean something in relation to somebody, so everything here hangs off yo. The short double line joins a married couple; the green dashed line marks the one relationship a tree cannot show by position — you are your grandparents' nieto. Plural forms take the masculine: los padres is parents, los abuelos is grandparents, los hijos is children.
